source: Tool-returned diagnostic text; original build/test raw logs are separately archived

items.action: govern.py new with ordinary Windows path
items.failure: WinError 3 in an existing long historical runtime path; no rule or baseline change
items.resolution: Use previously reviewed unchanged full-check wrapper with extended-length root and stat memoization; independently verify final history and all hashes.

items.failure: CS0117: .NET Framework CmsSigner has no PrivateKey setter
items.resolution: Use Framework certificate association, hold inspected CNG handle, revalidate policy/public key and resulting CMS; no claim of same-handle signing.

items.failure: 102-case run: 101 PASS / 1 FAIL; write handle was still allowed with attributes-only directory access
items.resolution: FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY|READ_ATTRIBUTES (0x81), share READ only; actual controlled writer denied error 32.

items.failure: Constructor on AtomicOutput not found through Activator overload
items.resolution: Explicit GetConstructor(Type[string])/Invoke; tested with public-only output in PowerShell 5 and pwsh.

items.failure: READ_ONLY_ENTRY_CONTRACT_FAILED: GUI launch did not update LASTEXITCODE synchronously
items.resolution: Use ProcessStartInfo/WaitForExit and process ExitCode; auto-signing arguments actually reject 21.

items.failure: Empty tool output from a quoted Python command; no successful mutation recorded
items.resolution: Use literal PowerShell here-string for Python; source hashes subsequently verified.

items.failure: SelectionStart=-1 because Windows PowerShell 5 interpreted a UTF-8 Chinese script search literal using its default script encoding
items.resolution: Use an ASCII NOT_CHECKED anchor; both final keyless preview stages and public certificate fields rendered and were visually inspected. No product code or private-key path executed.
